[size=5][b][color=#ff82af]What is this?[/color][/b][/size]

[b]Night Rework[/b] is a separate SMAPI add-on for [b]The Cunning Guest[/b]. It replaces only one thing in the base mod: what happens when you choose [b]"Approach her"[/b] from Sandra's night menu. Everything else in The Cunning Guest (story, schemes, suspicion, dates, dinners, endings) stays exactly as it is.

Instead of the original approach scenes, you get an [b]animated scene played over your farmhouse[/b] (green screen removed, so your own house and furniture stay visible behind it). It comes with a [b]climax gauge[/b], Sandra's [b]changing expressions[/b], sound effects synced to the animation, and dialogue that [b]stays out of the way[/b] unless you click for it.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff82af]Features[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Animated scene over the game world[/b] - a looping animation and a finish animation, with the green background removed so your farmhouse shows behind it. Smooth fade-to-black transitions.[/*]
[*][b]Climax gauge[/b] - a bar on the right edge fills by itself while the scene plays, faster when she's going faster. You don't have to click anything.[/*]
[*][b]Dialogue that doesn't interrupt[/b] - a small talk box in the top-left corner, with no game menus covering the animation. Only her first line appears by itself; after that, you click to hear more. Lines fade on their own after a few seconds.[/*]
[*][b]Optional teases[/b] - click during the scene and she may ask something of you (at most 2 per scene). Going along speeds her up and fills the gauge faster; refusing slows her down.[/*]
[*][b]The final question[/b] - when the gauge is full, she asks you for some information.
[list]
[*][b]Answer[/b] - she rewards you, and you get the [b]"Cum inside"[/b] option.[/*]
[*][b]Refuse[/b] - she finishes you anyway... but she won't let you approach her again for [b]3 days[/b].[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]16 expressions[/b] - Sandra's portrait in the talk box changes with every line's mood (smug, teasing, annoyed, laughing, blushing and more).[/*]
[*][b]Synced sound effects[/b] - impact sounds land on the exact animation frames and stay in sync when she speeds up or slows down. Finish sounds follow the finish animation, and she laughs now and then (laugh clips included).[/*]
[*][b]Progression in 3 stages[/b] - her dialogue changes as you keep coming back:
[list]
[*][b]Early[/b] (0-2 finished scenes): softer, still in control[/*]
[*][b]Mid[/b] (3-6): clear ownership, heavier demands[/*]
[*][b]Late[/b] (7+): maximum control[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Once per night[/b] - "Approach her" can only be used once each night.[/*]
[*][b]Optional NTR teases, OFF by default[/b] - only appear if you turn them on [i]and[/i] have 5+ finished scenes [i]and[/i] 8+ hearts with Sandra. With the option off, you will never see any of it.[/*]
[*][b]Fully editable[/b] - all dialogue, expressions, sound timing and balance live in plain JSON files and config.json.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff82af]Requirements[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or newer[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54216]Sandra's Mod - Safe Edition[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] (already required by The Cunning Guest)[/*]
[/list]
Everything else is included, sounds and Sandra's laugh too.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff82af]Installation[/color][/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]The Cunning Guest[/b] (and Content Patcher) first, and make sure the game runs.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder. You should end up with [b]Mods/TCGNightRework/manifest.json[/b].[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI. A [b]config.json[/b] is created in the mod folder on first launch.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Updating:[/b] delete the old [b]TCGNightRework[/b] folder first (you can keep your config.json), then unzip the new version. Your progress is stored in your save, not in the mod folder, so it carries over.

[b]Uninstalling:[/b] just delete the folder. Nothing in your save depends on this mod, and The Cunning Guest's own approach scenes come back automatically.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff82af]How to play[/color][/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Sandra has to be living in your farmhouse (part of The Cunning Guest's story).[/*]
[*]At [b]8:00 PM or later[/b], talk to Sandra inside your farmhouse with an empty hand (holding a giftable item gives her the gift instead).[/*]
[*]Her night menu opens. Pick [b]"Approach her"[/b].[/*]
[*]Choose [b]"Spend the night together"[/b]. (The other two options are coming in a future update.)[/*]
[*]The scene starts:
[list]
[*][b]Click[/b] (or press the action button) to dismiss a line, or to make her say something when nothing is on screen.[/*]
[*]Pick options with the mouse, or press [b]1 / 2 / 3[/b].[/*]
[*]Or just watch - the gauge fills by itself.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]When the gauge is full, answer her question (or don't), then enjoy the finish and her parting words.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]The game clock is paused during the scene, so you won't pass out mid-scene.[/*]
[*]"Approach her" only shows up in the night menu when The Cunning Guest allows it that night. Its own cooldown and mood rules still apply, and this mod records the night in The Cunning Guest's tracking too.[/*]
[*]If you refused her question, the option shows as locked, with the number of days left, until the 3 days are up.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff82af]Configuration (config.json)[/color][/b][/size]

Created on first launch in [b]Mods/TCGNightRework/config.json[/b]. The most useful settings:

[spoiler]
[b]Limits[/b]
[list]
[*][b]OncePerNight[/b] (true) - "Approach her" works once per night.[/*]
[*][b]LockoutDays[/b] (3) - days locked after refusing her question at the climax.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Climax gauge[/b]
[list]
[*][b]GaugeSecondsAtNormalSpeed[/b] (45) - seconds to fill the gauge with no input, at normal speed.[/*]
[*][b]GaugeCooperateBoost[/b] (0.08) - extra fill when you go along with a tease.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Dialogue[/b]
[list]
[*][b]LineAutoHideSeconds[/b] (8) - a line fades away by itself after this many seconds (0 = stays until you click).[/*]
[*][b]MaxTeasesPerScene[/b] (2) - how many optional teases can come up in one scene.[/*]
[*][b]ShowClickHint[/b] (true) - show the small "Click to talk" hint.[/*]
[*][b]TextScale[/b] (1.0) - size of the talk box text.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Sound[/b]
[list]
[*][b]EnableSounds[/b] (true)[/*]
[*][b]PlapVolume[/b] (0.75), [b]SplurtVolume[/b] (0.9), [b]LaughVolume[/b] (0.8) - multiplied by the game's own sound volume.[/*]
[*][b]LaughEveryMinSeconds[/b] / [b]LaughEveryMaxSeconds[/b] (16 / 32) - how often she laughs during the scene.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Progression[/b]
[list]
[*][b]MidAtCompletions[/b] (3), [b]LateAtCompletions[/b] (7) - finished scenes needed to reach each stage.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Optional NTR teases[/b]
[list]
[*][b]EnableNTRTeases[/b] ([b]false[/b]) - must be turned on to see any NTR content.[/*]
[*][b]NtrMinCompletions[/b] (5), [b]NtrMinHearts[/b] (8) - extra requirements even when it's on.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Display[/b]
[list]
[*][b]VideoScale[/b] (1.0), [b]VideoOffsetX[/b] / [b]VideoOffsetY[/b] (0) - size and position of the animation.[/*]
[*][b]BackdropDim[/b] (0) - darken the room behind the animation (0-1).[/*]
[*][b]SpeedMin[/b] / [b]SpeedMax[/b] (0.6 / 1.6) - how slow or fast the animation can go.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff82af]Customising[/color][/b][/size]

All content is in plain files inside [b]Mods/TCGNightRework/assets[/b]. Changes take effect at the next scene, with no restart needed.

[list]
[*][b]scenes/scene_early.json, scene_mid.json, scene_late.json[/b] - all of Sandra's lines for each stage. Each request has a [b]Type[/b]: [b]"info"[/b] is asked when the gauge is full, and [b]"tease"[/b] is an optional click-only line.[/*]
[*][b]scenes/ntr_teases.json[/b] - the optional NTR lines (only used when enabled and unlocked).[/*]
[*][b]expressions.json[/b] - which of the 16 faces each mood name uses.[/*]
[*][b]sfx/sync.json[/b] - the animation frame numbers where each sound plays.[/*]
[*][b]sfx/laugh/[/b] - Sandra's laugh clips. Replace or add .wav files to change her laugh.[/*]
[/list]
In dialogue text, [b]^[/b] starts a new line.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff82af]Console commands (SMAPI window)[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]tcg_night_status[/b] - shows whether the hook is active, tonight's status, the lockout, your stage and the NTR gate.[/*]
[*][b]tcg_night[/b] - opens the night option menu directly.[/*]
[*][b]tcg_night_scene[/b] - starts the scene directly (ignores the lockout and the once-per-night limit; for testing).[/*]
[*][b]tcg_night_setcount <number>[/b] - sets your finished-scene count, to try the mid (3) or late (7) stage.[/*]
[*][b]tcg_night_reset[/b] - clears the 3-day lockout and tonight's once-per-night flag.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff82af]Compatibility[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Made for [b]The Cunning Guest 1.0.8 / 1.0.9[/b]. It hooks into that mod's "Approach her" option. If a future version of The Cunning Guest changes how that works, the hook switches off safely (a warning appears in the SMAPI log) and the base mod behaves normally until this add-on is updated.[/*]
[*]Only replaces "Approach her". Every other part of The Cunning Guest is left alone.[/*]
[*][b]Single-player.[/b] Multiplayer is untested.[/*]
[*]Tested on Windows.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff82af]FAQ[/color][/b][/size]

[b]I don't see "Approach her" in the night menu.[/b]
That option comes from The Cunning Guest itself and follows its rules (Sandra living with you, time of day, cooldown, her mood). If she "doesn't look in the mood", that's the base mod's block, not this add-on.

[b]I picked "Approach her" but got the old scene.[/b]
Run [b]tcg_night_status[/b] in the SMAPI window. It should say [b]Hook: harmony[/b]. If not, check the SMAPI log for a warning from Night Rework - usually your version of The Cunning Guest isn't supported yet.

[b]There's no sound at all.[/b]
Check that [b]EnableSounds[/b] is true in config.json and that the game's sound volume isn't at 0 (the mod follows it). The sound files are in [b]assets/sfx/[/b].

[b]The sounds feel slightly off-beat.[/b]
Adjust the frame numbers in [b]assets/sfx/sync.json[/b]. Each number is an animation frame (24 per second).

[b]The talk box covers part of the animation on my screen.[/b]
Lower [b]TextScale[/b], or move the animation with [b]VideoOffsetX[/b] in config.json.

[b]Does refusing break anything?[/b]
No. Refusing just means a 3-day lockout - the scene still finishes, and it still counts towards your progress.

[b]Is my progress stored in the mod?[/b]
No. It's stored in your save file, per player.
